امتعضا (form VIII)
# اِمْتَعَضَا (imtaʕaḍā) /im.ta.ʕa.dˤaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
# اُمْتُعِضَا (umtuʕiḍā) /um.tu.ʕi.dˤaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
# اِمْتَعِضَا (imtaʕiḍā) /im.ta.ʕi.dˤaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
